description: Latest standard price per channel for one model, each with region, pricing mode, trust status, observation time and source snapshot, plus Batch / Flex / Priority / Ultrafast plan prices where a channel publishes them. List prices as published by each channel at observed_at, USD per 1M tokens unless stated; China-site price lists are in CNY, listed separately and never converted. Standard (on-demand) plan unless service_plan says otherwise. The channel's own page is authoritative. Aggregator prices are the marketplace's own and never the reference. A missing price is unknown, not free. Not purchasing advice.

channel.description: Channel id to restrict to, e.g. azure-datazone-eu, vertex-regional, openrouter

model.description: Model id such as openai/gpt-6.1-sol, or an alias the channels use (gpt-6.1-sol, claude-opus-5-5). Case-insensitive.

name: get_price
title: Get a model's prices on every channel
